title: Differentiate the single-variable expression and set the derivative to zero
content: Once the quantity to optimise is written as a function of one variable only, differentiate it and set the derivative equal to zero to find the stationary point(s). Watch for terms written as a fraction (e.g. k/r) — rewrite as k*r^-1 before differentiating, since the power rule doesn't apply directly to a fraction. Solve the resulting equation for the variable; exam answers are often left as an exact surd/fraction for one part and then rounded for a later part — check which the question asks for.
